$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (connectors-translation-service). Seeds the DORMANT `libretranslate` source that OCA\Integriq\Service\TranslationService tries when `deepl-translation` is not enabled. configuration.translationProvider 'libretranslate' selects the LibreTranslate request shape (POST /translate with q, source, target, format). The location is a placeholder: point it at your own LibreTranslate instance, add an API key through configuration.authentication.credentialRef when the instance requires one, and enable the source.

objects.name: LibreTranslate
objects.description: Translates text for other apps, such as minutes in decidiq, through a LibreTranslate instance you host. Set the instance address and enable the source.
